title: Booking herself and avoiding agents
summary: She mostly booked herself, suspecting agents of knocking down, and one theater job led to another.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: When you were going to these various
theaters, you didn't have an agent, did you? A booking agent or manager, something like that?

Most of the time I did it myself. But sometimes some agent would ask me if I would -- but I didn't bother much with the agents. I'll tell you why, because agents they kind of knocked down on you, you know. We called it when they Steal from you, knock down. So I didn't bother much. Most of the time, like if I was in a theater, like I'm in the Howard, somebody would come and say will you go to such and such a theater?
So one thing led to another??
